text:
Jean-Gabriel Pageau missed a short stretch in mid-November, was a game-time decision on Nov. 19, and has been in the lineup since. He scored on Wednesday against St. Louis, his second goal of the season. At 34, with 464 games as an Islander, he plays 15:30 a night as a checking center, with 47 hits and no power-play points among his 9.

His finishing has been unlucky (2 goals on 2.9 expected, shooting 8% against a usual mark near 14.5%), and the Islanders have scored 4.3 more goals than expected with him on the ice, so the points roughly even out. The concern is chances against. New York gets 44% of the 5-on-5 chance quality with him out there, almost 9 points worse than when he sits, and Evolving-Hockey had opponents gaining 0.19 expected goals per 60 with him on last season, bottom 4% of forwards. The puck skills hold up: Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 73% of his exits leaving the zone with possession. Our numbers project about 37 points.
headline: Jean-Gabriel Pageau back in the middle after a short absence
